scope: Synthetic recorded conversation. No business tools or user sessions executed. No credentials, hidden reasoning or provider replay included.
measurement: Post-compaction actual provider input tokens include cached tokens; JSON/4 estimates are not used in these tables.
grading: Strict original field checks are preserved. Semantic scores additionally accept explicitly listed representational equivalents, never missing/nonmatching facts. Every conversion is recorded. controlMatched reports only fields the uncompressed control answered correctly, to avoid automatically blaming compression for shared answer/grading issues.

methodology.pressureCounter: controlled JSON characters / 4, including tools; NOT actual provider tokenization
methodology.actualInputMeasurement: provider usage.inputTokens for the first ordinary request after compaction and for a blind follow-up audit; cached tokens included
methodology.finalToolValidation: Both arms receive up to two attempts, using the actual tool error receipt; all attempts count toward cost.
methodology.legacyDirectFinal: A legacy preparation may return no tool call, as production permits direct terminal replies. It adds no fake receipt; the same fixed final prose is appended in both arms.
methodology.persistentBridgeReplies: Real model produces a one-sentence acknowledgment; no audit result or correct answer is inserted into history.
methodology.reference: One uncompressed raw-business transcript control at each checkpoint; it is not fed to either arm.
methodology.armOrder: baseline first on odd phases, prepared first on even phases; no concurrent provider calls

summaryMergeStress.completedWork: All three merge cycles and four audits finished; original-journal model readback did not finish and is not a pass.

methodology.test: shared oldest-two-thirds summary fallback and original-journal readback
methodology.initialSummaries: 12 model-generated prepared handoffs from the supplied report, plus each original user correction and fixed final reply
methodology.simulatedPressure: Fixed window: usable input = 1.8 * the initial provider local wire-input estimate. Before subsequent merges append synthetic no-change status summaries until the initial pressure level is reached again. These add no requirements, answers or new business facts.
methodology.inputEstimator: Provider local wire projection, excluding duplicate internal providerReplay envelopes. Not billed tokenization or a production window change.
methodology.originalOnlyCanary: A synthetic checksum is in t01 journal only, deliberately absent from initial summaries. Recovery audit must read it.

summaryMergeStress.followUp: Probe now strips tool UI metadata through the same helper as the runtime and records visible readback calls. Not rerun with a real model; offline history and display-argument checks passed.

limitations: One continuous synthetic sample per variant; checks are not independent experiments.
Controlled pressure estimates are not billed tokenizer counts; use service usage for cost comparisons.
Cached input is included; shared prefixes and debug runs mean this is not a cold-cache comparison.
The later summary-only fixes were tested separately; main A/B did not enter the all-summary merge path.
Scoring code belongs to the experiment only; no semantic matching or correctness gate added to the runtime.
History tools can retrieve originals but do not guarantee the model notices and repairs missing facts.
